node.title: Re^2: Output redirection using “require” in perl
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: [Sandeep Kumar]: Note that using [doc://select] only redirects default [doc://print]s and [doc://write]s, it doesn't redirect, for example, [doc://print] statements explicitly made to a filehandle (print STDOUT ...) and it doesn't redirect the output of external commands.
